about: A map variable takes the map an imported algorithm returns, whole, by an <assign> whose expression is the call (docs/adr/0108, D5): `kept`, a map of three, takes the entries of `amounts` above `least` that `AmountsAbove` builds in a map of two. What it held before is replaced, not merged. A third entry above `least` fails the algorithm's put, which names no outcome, so the call fails: error.execution is raised and `kept` is as it was. A map is stated as the array of its entries, each [key, value], in the order its keys were first put. Expected values are derived from the documents, not observed from a backend.

steps.note: the one entry above 10 is the map the call returns
5 is not above 10, so the map returned is the same one entry
two entries above 10, in the order `amounts` holds them
a third entry above 10 fails the algorithm's put into its map of two: the call fails, error.execution is raised, and `kept` is as it was
the map returned replaces what `kept` held: 1 is gone, and 4 goes after 3
